moments.title: Edinburgh's Festival Season in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh Fringe Festival and Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo are both running throughout August, drawing huge crowds to the Scottish capital for a massive celebration of arts and culture.

source.l: Edinburgh Fringe / Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo

angles.name: Fringe Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is absolutely buzzing! The Fringe Festival is in full swing, bringing theatre, comedy, and music to every corner of the city. What's been your highlight so far?

angles.name: Tattoo Spectacle
angles.copy: The pipes, the drums, the castle! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is delivering spectacular performances nightly. Pure Scottish magic!

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament is nearing its climax, with Finals Day scheduled for Sunday, August 16th, at Lord's Cricket Ground. Matches continue today and mid-week in Cardiff for Welsh Fire.

angles.name: Cricket Countdown
angles.copy: Who's ready for Finals Day? The Hundred is heading to Lord's next Sunday, August 16th, for the big showdown! Who are you backing for the trophy?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Action
angles.copy: Still time to catch Welsh Fire in action before The Hundred finals! They're playing today and again on Wednesday, August 12th. Get down to Sophia Gardens or tune in!

moments.title: EFL Season Kicks Off Next Weekend
moments.blurb: The new English Football League season for the Championship, League One, and League Two begins across the weekend of August 14-16, with the Carabao Cup Round One concluding today.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: Get ready! The EFL season kicks off next weekend, August 14-16. Who are you tipping for promotion this year?

angles.name: Wrexham's Championship Debut
angles.copy: Wrexham are in the Championship! The new EFL season starts next weekend, August 14-16. Huge season ahead for the Red Dragons!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Top UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the number one spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 7-13, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at No.1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are reigning supreme on the UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Who else is loving this track?

angles.name: New Music Alert
angles.copy: New entries from Ariana Grande, Tame Impala, and Luke Combs are shaking up the chart this week! What's your favourite new tune?

moments.title: Happy 25th Birthday Arlo Parks
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter Arlo Parks, known for her Mercury Prize-winning album 'Collapsed in Sunbeams', turns 25 today.

angles.name: Arlo Turns 25
angles.copy: Sending big birthday love to the incredible Arlo Parks, who turns 25 today! What's your favourite track from 'Collapsed in Sunbeams'?

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday Kurtis Blow
moments.blurb: Pioneering American rapper and hip-hop artist Kurtis Blow, best known for hits like 'The Breaks', celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Legend
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary Kurtis Blow! 'The Breaks' is still an absolute anthem. What's your favourite track from a true hip-hop pioneer?

moments.title: Happy 77th Birthday Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: The iconic guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, Mark Knopfler, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: On Wednesday, the legendary Mark Knopfler of Dire Straits turns 77! What's your go-to Dire Straits track to hear that iconic guitar work?

moments.title: Happy 40th Birthday Danny Jones
moments.blurb: McFly guitarist and vocalist Danny Jones celebrates his 40th birthday on Thursday, August 13th.

angles.name: McFly Milestone
angles.copy: Can you believe it? McFly's Danny Jones turns the big 4-0 on Thursday! What's your favourite McFly song to celebrate?

moments.title: Happy 59th Birthday Noel Gallagher
moments.blurb: Oasis songwriting genius and High Flying Birds frontman Noel Gallagher celebrates his 59th birthday on Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Oasis Icon
angles.copy: The Chief turns 59 on Friday! Happy Birthday to Noel Gallagher, responsible for some of the greatest anthems ever. What's your top Noel track?

moments.title: Happy 37th Birthday Joe Jonas
moments.blurb: Pop sensation Joe Jonas, known for his work with the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Jonas Brother Turns 37
angles.copy: It's Joe Jonas's birthday on Saturday! The Jonas Brother turns 37. What's your favourite song from the band or DNCE?

moments.title: Happy 68th Birthday Madonna
moments.blurb: The undisputed Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: All hail the Queen! Madonna turns 68 on Sunday. What's the ultimate Madonna anthem that always gets you dancing?

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday Donnie Wahlberg
moments.blurb: New Kids on the Block member and actor Donnie Wahlberg celebrates his 57th birthday on Monday, August 17th.

angles.name: Blockhead Birthday
angles.copy: Big birthday shout out to Donnie Wahlberg, who turns 57 on Monday! What's your favourite New Kids on the Block classic?

moments.title: UK Set for Warm August Weather
moments.blurb: Parts of the UK, particularly England and Wales, are experiencing warm temperatures today, with the South East potentially reaching 32-33°C, as August is generally forecast to be warmer and drier than average.

angles.name: Sunshine Sunday
angles.copy: It's a scorcher in parts of the UK today! Temperatures hitting the low 30s in the South East. How are you enjoying the sunshine?

angles.name: Keeping Cool
angles.copy: London is heating up! If you're out and about, remember to stay hydrated and find some shade. What's your favourite way to beat the heat?
